jobDescriptions.text: Business Intelligence Developer. Build Power BI dashboards, DAX measures, and semantic models. Strong SQL Server skills. Gather stakeholder requirements. Tableau experience preferred.
Data Engineer. Design ETL/ELT pipelines in Python and SQL, integrate REST APIs, PostgreSQL on AWS, data quality controls. Experience with Snowflake and Airflow required.
Palantir Foundry Developer. Build Workshop applications, Ontology objects, Actions, and AIP workflows for operational decisions. Active security clearance required.
Power Platform Developer. Build Power Apps canvas apps, Power Automate flows, SharePoint Online solutions, and PCF controls in TypeScript. Dataverse administration experience preferred.
Full Stack Developer. React, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, Git and CI/CD. Five years of professional Kubernetes and Go experience required.
Production Planning Analyst. Manage production schedules, material constraints, capacity planning, and on-time delivery KPIs using SQL and Excel. SAP PP experience required.
Operations Analyst. Map business processes, define KPIs, lead continuous improvement with Lean Six Sigma, and present findings to leaders. Black Belt certification preferred.
Automation Engineer. Automate reporting and reconciliation with Python, schedule processing, RPA bots, and Excel VBA. UiPath certification preferred.
Cloud Application Developer. Azure Functions, Azure SQL, API Management, Key Vault, Application Insights, Entra ID and OAuth. Microsoft Azure certification required.
Analytics Team Lead. Lead analysts, set reporting standards, partner with IT and cybersecurity, and deliver governed executive dashboards. Budget ownership of more than one million dollars required.
